scope: synthetic database/database-artifact local-UAT evidence only; not launch readiness
notes: This policy is generic and secret-safe.
The verifier validates the policy shape with synthetic data only.
Hosted/protected/deploy and production readiness require object storage, hosted logging/monitoring, and approved deletion workflows.

data_classes.rollback_note: Restore the SQLite database from the prior known-good backup and verify workspace/session checksums before using local-UAT access.

data_classes.storage: sqag_quote_publication_versions, sqag_quote_publication_artifacts, and run-scoped generated_quote_version object artifacts
data_classes.lifecycle_note: Replacement artifacts are staged under an immutable generation-run identity. The current published version remains visible until an atomic promotion. Failed and superseded versions stay linked to the generation-run retention graph; legal hold blocks version deletion. Retention deletes version bytes before metadata and the linked forensic graph, and never deletes the current published version independently.
data_classes.rollback_note: Restore publication-version metadata and its exact run-scoped artifacts together; verify checksums and the quote session's authoritative published run before downloads are re-enabled.
Restore generated artifact rows together with quote-session metadata from the same backup set; verify artifact checksums before download routes are re-enabled.
Restore uploaded reference artifact rows from the same backup set as pricing/profile metadata and validate row counts plus checksums.
Restore profile layout assets with their owning profile rows and verify workspace/profile ownership metadata before generation is enabled.
Restore pricing visual assets with their owning pricing-reference rows and verify workspace/reference ownership metadata before reference exports are enabled.

data_classes.lifecycle_note: Run-linked audit rows are deleted with their run graph; explicitly feedback-linked audit rows are deleted with their feedback graph; standalone audit rows use their own indexed three-calendar-year expiry, controlled-delete authorization, legal-hold check, receipt, bounded batch metrics, fair cross-kind progress, and retry-safe transaction. A held generation run also preserves feedback linked only through that run's exact quote session.
data_classes.rollback_note: Restore the immutable run, evidence, and audit rows from the same workspace-scoped backup set and verify evidence digests before access is restored.

data_classes.lifecycle_note: First closure expires three calendar years from closure. Reopening clears the current closed_at without shortening submission or current lifecycle expiry. Reclosure records a new current closed_at and expiry while prior closures remain in status history. Reopen transitions require a bounded reason; every transition is audited with a derived reopen count and unusual repeated reopening is flagged for support review. Legal holds suspend deletion without rewriting lifecycle dates or extending linked runs or artifacts. Status transitions and retention deletion share the workspace-scoped feedback transaction lock, and deletion rechecks current status, expiry, and hold state after locking.
data_classes.rollback_note: Restore feedback records together with their status history and linked run/session identifiers; do not duplicate canonical generation evidence.

data_classes.storage: _logs local-UAT only until hosted logging exists
data_classes.rollback_note: Logs are not restored as authoritative app data; use them only for privacy-minimized diagnostics and keep hosted logging as a blocker.

data_classes.storage: operator-managed encrypted backup location outside the repository
data_classes.rollback_note: Keep at least one prior known-good backup for local-UAT evidence drills, and verify restore before discarding the previous backup.
